infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Safety uses your location when you activate SOS so your trusted contacts can find you.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Safety uses your location when you activate SOS so your trusted contacts can find you.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Safety uses your location during an active SOS so your trusted contacts can follow your emergency location.

plugins.microphonePermission: Safety uses your microphone only while an active SOS recording is running.
